Alphaa used to look like every other SaaS product: charts, scores, tabs, a settings page with 40 options.

Then I watched how owners actually work. They don't open dashboards. They read messages between jobs.

So we rebuilt it as an agent that talks to you:
"I asked ChatGPT about you this morning. Here's what it said. Here's my fix. Tap approve."

No forms. No learning curve. One conversation.

It was a painful rebuild. It was the right one.

caption:
Not all reviews are equal when AI decides who to recommend.

Reviews AI can actually use are:

On public sites. Google, Yelp, your industry's directories.
Recent. A steady trickle beats an old pile from 2019.
Specific. "Fixed our furnace the same day" tells AI what you do and how well. "Great!" tells it nothing.
Answered. Replying to every review, good or bad, shows you're active and real.

The 60-second fix: next time a happy customer thanks you, ask them to mention what you did for them in the review.
